svg.title: Cristian Barreiro — original portfolio banner (static foundation)
svg.desc: Pixel-accurate static foundation. The unmodified reference artwork is embedded intact so its typography, gradients, icons, details, and spacing remain exact.
svg.metadata: Static only. Future animation candidates already present in the source include circuit light points, the terminal cursor, the portfolio button outline, and ambient highlights. Keep all original text, icons, and principal geometry static. No animation is applied in this foundation.

Phase 2 review: no motion is applied. This source contains only one embedded raster image, with no independently editable circuit paths, light nodes, button outline, or terminal cursor. Adding overlays would reconstruct or duplicate details and could compromise fidelity, so all proposed effects were skipped. This file is a static safe copy pending separately editable source elements.
